clauses.clause: Bicycle: 7.5 m/s, WASD relative to the bike; after dismount it stands on the player's side of any fence/wall.
clauses.note: Both physical quality runs sustain actual7.5m/s, A/D steer relative to bike and S brakes then reverses. After physical E by depot facade and real privacy fence, parked bike and rider stay in same separating half-plane. All68 new images personally inspected on18 retained sheets: visible frame remains beside rider outside depot and east of brown fence. Earlier expired/incorrectly targeted fence trials retained and explicitly excluded. Seven rejection controls pass. Source Bicycle.reachable uses rider-to-frame solid raycasts, supporting same-side placement beyond the sampled wall/fence.
